answer: Every identity starts by locking a two-asset bond split between token and stablecoin as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. The network catches failing a sampled proof-of-work audit through audits sampled every epoch. When the proof lands, the bond is slashed in tiers: ten percent first offence, fifty percent second, all of it third. A zenith with no bond earns no attestation rights. A farm needs a fresh velvet per fake, each costing a full bond. Each ferrous stake is slashable the moment its owner cheats.
